chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
'Amir al-Mu'minin (peace be upon him) used to make the hermaphrodite inherit, (based upon) where it urinated from.'

key_terms.مِنْ حَيْثُ يَبُولُ: From where it urinates (indicating the basis for determining sex)
key_terms.يُوَرِّثُ: He makes inherit / He grants inheritance

ai.seo_question: How is inheritance determined for a hermaphrodite in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi outlines the practical legal methodology (fiqh) employed by Imam Ali (AS) to determine the inheritance share of a hermaphrodite (al-khuntha) by observing the primary sex characteristic, specifically the site of urination. This ruling reflects the early Shia jurisprudential approach of relying on observable physical signs to resolve ambiguity in inheritance distribution, ensuring fairness when gender is indeterminate. It highlights the dynamic application of divine law through the Imam's discernment of natural indicators.
